name: Workshop Change Verification Route v0.2 Challenger
purpose: Choose bounded evidence routes for changes spanning the Organ Fabric runtime, archive, Hub, and passive Mirror archive seam, using every declared affected surface.

inputs.name: risk
inputs.description: Mike-assigned risk from one to five.

inputs.name: affectedSurfaces
inputs.description: Explicit bounded Workshop surface tokens touched by the change.

outputs.name: route
outputs.description: Ordered evidence route tokens bound to the exact registry.

requiredCases.description: A high-risk Fabric Hub change requires observed browser evidence, archive reload evidence, and an isolated worktree.
A risky archive connector change retains runtime, persistence, transport, and regression evidence.

desiredCases.description: Archive data changes include deterministic round-trip and reload evidence.

invariants: Every required input is read by the graph or explicitly required as guard-only.
Every emitted route token resolves through the exact packaged registry.
Never claim a browser path passed from syntax evidence alone.
Never install, promote, canonize, or mutate Foundation from an advisory route.
boundaries: Risk and affected surfaces are explicit human inputs, not inferred.
Unknown and empty affected-surface sets are refused.
The route is evidence advice and grants no execution or merge authority.
